summary: All three sanity cases ran from the repository root at head 6607e67 (PR #117, branch raunakTruxt/axm-748-f8b9bc) after npm ci, and all three passed: "Dashboard renders" (node --test test/smoke.test.js test/dashboard-view.test.js, 5/5), "Health endpoints" (node --test test/health.test.js test/health-freshness.test.js, 16/16) and "Lint" (npm run lint, eslint clean). No case was skipped: the PR touches package.json and package-lock.json, which matches every case path scope. The full suite (npm test) also passed at 65/65, including the one test file the PR adds, test/upstream-sync.axios.test.js, whose three cases exercise JSON handling, redirect and credential boundaries, proxy routing, HTTP-failure rejection under an inherited validateStatus (GHSA-w9j2-pvgh-6h63) and real request timeouts against a local server. The change itself is dependency-only: axios 0.21.1 to 0.34.0 (lockfile resolves axios 0.34.0) plus a new follow-redirects ^1.16.2 override (installed 1.16.2); no src/ or views/ code changed, so the dashboard and health behaviour is covered by the pre-existing tests rather than new ones. Comparable npm audit --package-lock-only runs show 11 findings at base e5a3d26 including axios and follow-redirects (5 high, 2 critical) against 9 at head (3 high, 2 critical) with the axios and follow-redirects entries gone and no new advisory introduced; the remaining 9 sit in express, body-parser, qs, path-to-regexp, send, serve-static, cookie, proxy-addr and lodash, which are outside this dependency group and pre-date the PR. No regressions, no flaky runs, and no test was weakened or removed. Coverage gap worth noting for follow-up: nothing covers src/worker.js, and the remaining express and lodash advisory groups are untouched by this ticket.
